# Step - with

`with` · category: [Modulators and options](../../traversal/step_reference.md#modulators-and-options)

On g sets an execution option (g.with("key", value), see the book page Execution Options Reference); after a step a WithOptions token configures it.

## Forms

```text
with(arg1: WithOptions)
with(arg1: WithOptions, arg2: WithOptions)
with(arg1: string, arg2: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.with("random.seed", 7).v().count().next()   // 6
```
